    com.impinj.octane.ReaderMode
    The ReaderMode enum is no longer supported.

    Use Settings.setRfMode(Integer) and Settings.getRfMode() to set the RF Mode instead.

    An enumeration defining the choices for the communications parameters used between the reader and tags. These are pre-selected and tested values for Tari, M, TR etc which have been optimized for the best performance with Impinj readers.
